title: Assemble the walls of a two-storey house
description: Write the assembly manifest for the walls of a two-storey house, 5.3 m wide and 7.3 m deep, from the five atoms in its blueprint. It dresses one real building in Oshiage 2 to accuracy level A1: typical walls, windows and a door on a box close to the real outline. There is no roof in this test.

reference_pack.source: 3D City Model (Project PLATEAU), Sumida ward, fiscal 2023, edited
reference_pack.licence: Public Data License 1.0 (compatible with CC BY 4.0)

reference_pack.value_or_path: Each storey is a ring: 5 modules along the front, a corner post, 7 along the right side, a corner post, 5 along the back, a corner post, 7 along the left side, a corner post. That is 24 modules and 4 posts a storey. Ground storey: 1 door module in the middle of the front, 6 window modules, 17 plain modules. Upper storey: 8 window modules, 16 plain modules. One door leaf hangs in the door module.

Join every module to its neighbours in the ring with facade_edge, including the joint that closes the ring. Join every upper module and post to the one below it with storey_stack. The origin is the first module of the ground storey's front run.
The source has no facades, so where the real windows and door are is not known. Any sensible arrangement is accepted.
